When a package's *bare* id (`@vitejs/test-dep-cjs-css-main-field`) resolves to a CSS file through its `main` field, it slipped past that plugin and was handled by `vite:dep-pre-bundle`'s `resolveResult`, which treated the CSS file as a JS module to bundle — breaking style application.
